name: web-mobile-product-and-checkout-screens-over-dark-interior-photo
title: Two white phone screens (product details and checkout) over a moody dark interior photo of a man on a sofa
whatItIs: A dark warm-toned photo of a man reading in an armchair with a milkshake beside him, overlaid with two staggered white mobile screens: a product detail with a violet-backdrop model, thumbnail strip, price, colour and size selectors and a black Add to cart, and a checkout with two items, discount code, cost lines, benefit list, violet and yellow express buttons and a black Others Pay button.
whatItMeans: Warm and cinematic; bright UI over a dim lifestyle scene draws attention to the flow.
techniques: Overlay white screens on a dark editorial photo.
Keep buttons black with brand-coloured express pay.
Use a violet product backdrop as accent.

vocabulary.definition: UI screens placed on a full-bleed photo.
Small product photos below the main image.
